title: MAI Bridge
objective: Implement the bounded MAI bridge, preserving ARI resource identity, provenance and rights/use-capability boundaries while MAI retains map/package/placeable/tileset semantics, coordinates, layers and import translation authority.

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-11
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-15 is completed_verified and owns large-library indexed query, pagination and lazy retrieval only.

ARI-16 resolves compatible, available and capability-allowed ARI visual resources into existing MAI package/asset/placeable/tileset identities without creating a second asset ledger or mutating either owner domain.
MAI remains owner of map visual semantics, coordinates, transforms, layers, placeables and import translation.
ARI resource identity, provenance, provider-reference boundaries and rights/use-capability evidence remain unchanged by the bridge.
ARI-17 AAI bridge work and all later ARI implementation remain inactive until separately governed-started.

changed_since_previous: matching RED production module was implemented on the same bounded branch

execution_governance_note.correction: Terminal closeout records the actual evidence and does not fabricate a prior start checkpoint. Future units remain subject to the bootstrap start-checkpoint rule.

next_action: ARI-16 is terminally complete. ARI-17 is the strict successor and remains selected_not_started until a separate governed start.
